teaser.en: The second Mtsaye: a scrambling Grewia of the coastal thicket.
teaser.sw: Mtsaye wa pili: Grewia inayotambaa ya vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani.
teaser.dg: *Mtsaye* wa phiri: *Grewia* inayoambala ya vitsaka vya pwani.

summary.en: This Mtsaye is Grewia vaughanii, a scrambling shrub of the East African coast. Pakia gives it the same Digo name as Grewia glandulosa.
summary.sw: Mtsaye huu ni Grewia vaughanii, kichaka kinachotambaa cha pwani ya Afrika Mashariki. Pakia anaupa jina lilelile la Kidigo kama Grewia glandulosa.
summary.dg: *Mtsaye* uhu ni *Grewia vaughanii*, chitsaka chinachoambala cha pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki. Pakia anaupha dzina ra Chidigo sawa na ra *Grewia glandulosa*.

about.en: Grewia vaughanii is a shrub or scrambler with alternate, toothed leaves that have three main veins from the base. Its small flowers have five narrow petals, and its fruits are small and lobed, as in other Grewias.
about.sw: Grewia vaughanii ni kichaka au mmea unaotambaa, wenye majani yanayopishana, yenye meno, na mishipa mitatu mikuu kutoka kwenye kitako. Maua yake madogo yana petali tano nyembamba, na matunda yake ni madogo yenye pindo, kama ilivyo kwa Grewia nyingine.
about.dg: *Grewia vaughanii* ni chitsaka au mmea unaoambala, wenye makodza ganagomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kupishana, genye meno kanda-kanda na mishipa mikulu mihahu inayoandzira photsi ya kodza. Maruwage ni madide, na makodza ga ruwa matsano membamba, na matundage ni madide na ganaganyika kpwa seemu, dza ga *Grewia* zanjina.

where.en: It grows in coastal thicket and bushland of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka-mwitu vizito na vichaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera vitsakani na weruni mwa pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsaye but gives no meaning or shared names. The same name is used for Grewia glandulosa, so the Digo appear to treat the two as one kind of plant. Its scientific name is Grewia vaughanii.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsaye lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina hilohilo hutumika kwa Grewia glandulosa, kwa hiyo inaonekana Wadigo huichukulia mimea hii miwili kuwa aina moja. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Grewia vaughanii.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsaye*, ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ganagohumirwa ni luga zanjina. Dzina hiri hiri nkuhumirwa piya kpwa *Grewia glandulosa*, kpwa hivyo inaonekana Adigo anaiona mimea iyo miiri kukala ni aina mwenga. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Grewia vaughanii*.
